mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 9.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE > 9.0%, or Rank IC for UNRATE > 9.0% is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates broad economic contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced revenue growth expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when both INDPRO and HOUST decline, or Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Strong economic growth (GDPC1 growth rate > 2.0% annualized) combined with rising housing starts (HOUST > 0.5% MoM) signals robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth rate > 2.0% annualized AND HOUST > 0.5% MoM
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when the trigger condition is met, or Rank IC for the joint condition is below 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: CPI inflation exceeding 3.0% annually signals rising inflation expectations that prompt monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.0% annualized, or Rank IC for CPIAUCSL > 3.0% is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate above 8.5% consistently correlates with weak consumer spending and lower corporate profits, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE > 8.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) indicate strong residential construction activity that boosts related sectors and consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when HOUST is rising, or Rank IC for HOUST is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production growth exceeding 1.0% monthly signals strong manufacturing output during economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO growth > 1.0% monthly, or Rank IC for INDPRO growth > 1.0% is below 0.02.
